architecture_summary: Modular React app. Pages in src/pages/. Shared UI in src/components/. Neubrutalist CSS via Tailwind. React Router v6 for navigation. No state management lib (use React context for auth/user).

tickets.title: Create base Tailwind config and global styles
tickets.description: Set up Tailwind CSS. Neubrutalist theme: 3px solid black borders, high-contrast colors, system-ui font stack. Global styles for body, headings, buttons. Reset margins/padding.
acceptance_criteria: Tailwind config match neubrutalist design (black borders, bold colors)
Global styles apply to all pages

tickets.title: Build shared UI components from showcase screens
tickets.description: Extract reusable components: Button, Input, Badge. Neubrutalist styling. Props: variant, size, disabled. Storybook-style showcase page for visual regression testing.

tickets.title: Implement auth pages (login/register)
tickets.description: Login/Register page. Form validation: email format, password min 8 chars. Neubrutalist styling. Mock auth flow (no backend yet).

tickets.title: Build home screen with hero and catalog preview
tickets.description: Home page: hero section + catalog grid. Neubrutalist layout. Responsive: mobile/desktop. Mock data for catalog items.
acceptance_criteria: Click catalog item navigate to detail

tickets.title: Implement catalog detail pages
tickets.description: Catalog detail page. Neubrutalist layout. Mock data for trip details. Back navigation to home.

tickets.title: Build order form page
tickets.description: Order form: input fields, quantity selector, submit button. Neubrutalist styling. Form validation. Mock submission.

tickets.title: Create 404 and loader components
tickets.description: 404 page: neubrutalist bento layout. Loader: animated spinner. Both match Stitch design.

tickets.title: App shell, navigation bar, and router wiring (src/App.jsx)
tickets.description: App shell: sidebar navigation, header. React Router v6 setup. Protected routes for auth. Neubrutalist styling. Responsive layout.
